panels.title: Requests (period)

panels.description:
This is the percentage of successful requests over the entire period in the top-right hand corner.

NOTE: Ignoring 404s in this metric, since a 404 is a normal response for errant/invalid request.  This helps prevent this percentage from being affected by typical web scanners and security probes.
panels.title: % Success (period)

panels.description: This is the number of successful requests in the last minute.  Successful being 1xx or 2xx by the standard HTTP definition.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", source_app=~"$source_app", destination_workload_namespace=~"$destination_workload_namespace",destination_service_name=~"$destination_service_name", response_code=~"(1|2).*" }[$__range])))

This graph can help assess and help us meet SLA requirements as far as the responsive time of our services.

For a more detailed latency graph broken out by ingress please open the closed tab at the bottom because it is very CPU intensive.
panels.title: Latency (Average Percentiles)

panels.description:
Shows total bandwidth (incoming + outgoing) for the service, based on request and response bytes per second.

More info: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-02-24-how-to-monitor-istio-request-bytes-and-istio-response-bytes-metrics/view#:~:text=How%20to%20Monitor%20istio_request_bytes%20and%20istio_response_bytes%20Metrics
panels.title: Combined Bandwidth

panels.description:
Shows the average request size sent by the service (bytes/request), calculated from request byte totals divided by request counts.

More info: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-02-24-how-to-monitor-istio-request-bytes-and-istio-response-bytes-metrics/view#:~:text=How%20to%20Monitor%20istio_request_bytes%20and%20istio_response_bytes%20Metrics
panels.title: Average Request Size (in progress)

panels.description:
Shows the average response size sent by the service (bytes/response), based on response byte totals divided by response counts.

panels.title: Average Response Size
